outline: 本課程授課內容涵蓋廣泛共計有：(1)工程估價之基本認識、(2)工程估價之內涵、(3)各種工程之估價：1.假設工程2.基礎工程3.土石方工程4.純混凝土工程5.鋼筋混凝土工程6.預力混凝土工程7.鋼結構工程8.建築工程9.機電及附屬設備工程 。
schedule:
1. Instructor : Yu-GOON WANG
2.Course objectives : Fundamental concept of cost and cost classification .Discussion of sunk cost fallacy for construction sector. Learn the breakdown plus quantity survey approach in order to generate construction cost information . Detailing when, where and how to utility cost information. Basics of construction contracting.
3. Main Topics :
 Essentials of cost concept . •What is cost? •Why cost information matters •When , Where &How to utilize cost information. •The difference of construction cost between owners and contractors.
 Breakdown plus Quality surrey approach to construction cost.
 Market price surrey approach to construction cost
 Basics of construction contracting.
4. Percentile distribution of final grades:
 Attendance, Homework & Participation in class activities. 50%
 Midterm Exam. 25%
 Final Exam. 25%
●Review & Discussion of the exam. Problems will be conducted for both midterm & final exam.
●Final exam. will be arranged at least one week ahead school scheduled exam. date .

Construction contracting, Richard H. Clough & Glenn A. Sears Reference Book: Construction Cost Engineering Handbook, Anghel Patrascy 1
